item_verdicts.contrast: passes - the axis and annotation text is near-black or the repository's declared reference grey #929292 on white and reads clearly against it, including the grey threshold annotation at the top of the plot.
item_verdicts.data_ink: passes - the four markers and their connecting line, the dashed power-law fit and the dotted threshold line carry the visual weight on a plain white field; nothing is drawn that is not the measurement or a reference the caption uses.
item_verdicts.decoration: passes - no gradient, background fill, shading, gridline or frame appears anywhere in the rendered PNG; the axes are despined; the only non-data ink is the dotted threshold reference, which the caption names.
item_verdicts.label_collision: passes - in the rendered PNG the 'threshold 1.0e-03' annotation sits above the dotted line in clear space, the 'fitted order 1.97' annotation sits below-left of the dashed line in empty space, neither overlaps the data line or the other label, and no label is clipped at the canvas edge.
item_verdicts.legibility: passes - the rendered PNG shows one log-log series of four band-residual points joined by a blue line with circle markers, a dashed fit line beneath it and a grey dotted threshold line; the axis labels 'radial grid spacing [m]' and 'band residual / profile current', the decade tick labels and both annotations ('threshold 1.0e-03', 'fitted order 1.97') are all readable at a glance.
item_verdicts.table_form: passes - the image is a log-log convergence plot of a residual against grid spacing; the four points are given as a plot because their slope is the result, so nothing it depicts is naturally a table.
